_read_me: Operator directive 2026-09-23 §二: for a known periodic activity keep its identity, the roles it
applies to, reliable start/end times, the cadence or the next-open condition, the participation
conditions, the knowledge and the historically successful path, what to prepare in advance, and
this occurrence's completion and reward state.
Two of those keep null and must stay null until the client is read again: 'start' and 'end' are
the minute a window opens and closes, and this project has never measured either one for any
event.  §二 is explicit -- 如果时间信息不可靠，保留 UNKNOWN，不编造活动时间 -- so the honest
answer is 'next_open_condition', which records what the game itself printed (a cooldown, a
countdown, a stage) instead of a wall-clock guess.
'gate' is this project's own vocabulary: VERIFIED = a live client reading backs it, REVIEWED =

events.name: 巨熊行动

applies_to_roles.note: an alliance PvE objective; no per-role gating was ever observed, and this corpus has one bound role

next_open_condition.how_to_read_it: the client prints the remaining cooldown on the 狩猎陷阱 page, and prints 距开始 there for an upcoming hunt

participation_conditions: an alliance member (the hunt is reached through 联盟 -> 联盟领地 -> 特殊建筑 -> 狩猎陷阱)
a march slot that is not reserved for stamina (that reservation outranks this event; measured 2026-09-21)
the hunt must be in its window: the client draws its START_RALLY control only while it is open
prepare: keep one normal march slot free at the window; at capacity 3 the stamina reservation already owns one and the reservation, not the event, is what blocks (measured 2026-09-21)
have the leader and member troop presets saved before the rally opens, because the window is short
do not claim a rally succeeded without reading a battle report: result_verification is still PENDING_BATTLE_REPORT

occurrence.note: the 2026-09-09 occurrence ended and went on cooldown; nothing about it may be replayed

events.name: 最强王国
unwired_steps: specific EVENT_MINIMUM_GUARANTEE skill selection and verifier-bound reward-tier claim; use only live UI planner fallback until connected

next_open_condition.note: the client printed a per-stage countdown, not a schedule for the next occurrence, so no next-open time is claimed

participation_conditions: the event page must be reachable (entry HOME/常规活动 -> EVENT)
for the minimum-guarantee goal: points_missing > 0, or a completed tier that is not claimed
prepare: keep a scoring route that is verified on this client: 击败野兽 through Intel wild beasts measured 10-15 stamina per mission on this account
the first personal tier is 80,000 points and the 11,250 in the snapshot was a partial reading, so plan the remainder from a fresh reading rather than from that snapshot
do not replay the 2026-09-09 stage; its per-stage countdown had already elapsed

occurrence.note: the 2026-09-09 occurrence was mid-stage when observed and its stage countdown has long elapsed
